descriptionZhs: 获得3点敏捷，失去2点力量。你的回合开始时，给予自己1层虚弱。离开隐匿状态时撤销此状态带来的力量与敏捷变化。
descriptionEng: Gain 3 Dexterity and lose 2 Strength. At the start of your turn, gain 1 Weak. Leaving the Hidden State reverses the Strength and Dexterity changes from this state.
smartDescriptionZhs: 获得3点敏捷，失去2点力量。你的回合开始时，给予自己1层虚弱。离开隐匿状态时撤销此状态带来的力量与敏捷变化。
smartDescriptionEng: Gain 3 Dexterity and lose 2 Strength. At the start of your turn, gain 1 Weak. Leaving the Hidden State reverses the Strength and Dexterity changes from this state.
notes: 使用原版力量与敏捷；记录实际增减，退出时精确撤销此状态的贡献，保留其他来源。

descriptionZhs: 获得2点力量，失去1点敏捷。你的回合开始时，给予所有敌人1层易伤。离开开豪状态时撤销此状态带来的力量与敏捷变化。
descriptionEng: Gain 2 Strength and lose 1 Dexterity. At the start of your turn, apply 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies. Leaving Hao Mode reverses the Strength and Dexterity changes from this state.
smartDescriptionZhs: 获得2点力量，失去1点敏捷。你的回合开始时，给予所有敌人1层易伤。离开开豪状态时撤销此状态带来的力量与敏捷变化。
smartDescriptionEng: Gain 2 Strength and lose 1 Dexterity. At the start of your turn, apply 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies. Leaving Hao Mode reverses the Strength and Dexterity changes from this state.
notes: 使用原版力量与敏捷；记录实际增减，退出时精确撤销此状态的贡献，保留其他来源。

smartDescriptionZhs: 每回合首次在隐匿状态与开豪状态之间切换时，抽[blue]{Amount}[/blue]张牌。尚无状态时第一次进入状态不会触发。
smartDescriptionEng: The first time each turn you switch between Hidden State and Hao Mode, draw [blue]{Amount}[/blue] cards. Entering a state for the first time does not trigger this effect.

smartDescriptionZhs: 回合内，每次获得或失去豪意值时，获得[blue]{Amount}[/blue]点格挡。
smartDescriptionEng: During a turn, whenever you gain or lose Hao, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Block.
notes: 监听自身豪意数值变化；仅自己的回合触发，每次变化获得Amount格挡，不按豪意点数倍乘，无次数限制。
